summary: Comprehensive testing of RENFFR OPEN tennis app after 3D rebuild. All features working correctly. Fixed critical backend bug where new surfaces (Kunstgras, Smashcourt) were not accepted by API.

fixed.issue: Backend only accepted 3 surfaces (hard, clay, grass) but frontend has 5 surfaces including artificial (Kunstgras) and smashcourt
fixed.fix: Updated server.py line 56 to include 'artificial' and 'smashcourt' in surface Literal type

tests: Root endpoint returns RENFFR OPEN Tennis API message
Create match success with correct rating points
Home page loads with RENFFR OPEN branding
Setup page displays all 5 court surfaces in a row
Each surface has distinct color dot indicator
2D view renders blue hard court with white lines, players, ball, crowd
3D view renders with side-angle camera, stadium, spectators, umpire chair
2D/3D toggle button works both ways without crashing
Scoreboard displays player names and scores
Match info panel shows surface type and opponent
History page loads with surface filter buttons including Kunstgras and Smashcourt

critical_code_review_comments: Backend surface validation was out of sync with frontend - now fixed
seed_data_creation: Created test matches with TEST_ prefix for various surfaces and difficulties
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 court surfaces now work end-to-end. The 3D view auto-fallbacks to 2D in low-GPU environments but manual toggle works. AudioContext warnings in console are expected for headless browsers. Test data prefixed with TEST_ was created during testing.
